# Block catalogue

Blocks are page sections stored as a YAML list under `blocks:` in page frontmatter.
Files per block: `templates/blocks/<type>.html.twig`, `blueprints/blocks/<type>.yaml`, optional `css/blocks/<type>.css`.

## Shape (required, this is what Admin2 reads and writes)

```yaml
blocks:
  - type: features      # block type
    background: alt     # shared settings: flat on the item
    features:           # content: nested under a key equal to the type
      heading: Why us
      items:
        - { icon: fa-bolt, title: Fast, text: No database. }
```

If you write content flat by mistake, run `php user/themes/maw-starter/bin/maw.php normalize`.

## Shared settings (flat on every block)

| Field | Type / values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | text | '' |
| `background` | none \| alt \| soft \| accent \| dark | 'none' |
| `bg_color` | colorpicker | '' |
| `text_color` | auto \| light \| dark | 'auto' |
| `spacing` | none \| sm \| md \| lg | 'md' |
| `width` | narrow \| default \| wide \| full | 'default' |
| `align` | left \| center | 'left' |
| `class` | text | '' |
| `reveal` | 1 \| 0 | 0 |
| `hidden` | 1 \| 0 | 0 |

`buttons` (on blocks that list it) is `[{label, url, style: primary|secondary|ghost, icon, new_tab}]`.
Images are a filename in the page folder, `user://media/...`, `theme://images/...` or a full URL.

## Types

- [`cards`](#cards): Grid of hand-written cards (image, meta, title, text, link). For listing real pages use the collection block.
- [`collection`](#collection): Lists real pages as cards or a list. source: @self.children, a route like /blog, or "@taxonomy.tag: news".
- [`contact`](#contact): Contact details beside a Form plugin form. `form` is the name of a form under `forms:` in the same page frontmatter.
- [`cta`](#cta): Centered heading, text and buttons on an accent background (change with background setting).
- [`embed`](#embed): Responsive iframe for YouTube, Vimeo, maps or any https URL. Ratio like "16 / 9" or "4 / 3".
- [`faq`](#faq): Accordion of questions and markdown answers. Outputs FAQPage JSON-LD (set schema false to disable).
- [`features`](#features): Grid of icon + title + text items. Use for services, benefits, how-it-works.
- [`gallery`](#gallery): Image grid from a hand-picked list, or every image in the page folder (from_page).
- [`hero`](#hero): Large intro section with headline, text, buttons and optional image. First hero on a page uses <h1>.
- [`logos`](#logos): Row of client/partner logos (grayscale until hover). Name is shown as text when no image.
- [`media-text`](#media-text): Image beside text, with optional checklist and buttons. Alternate image_side for zig-zag layouts.
- [`pricing`](#pricing): Pricing plans with features (one per line), button, and an optional featured plan.
- [`rich-text`](#rich-text): Markdown content section with optional heading and buttons. Narrow width by default.
- [`spacer`](#spacer): Vertical space with optional divider line. Ignores shared section settings except class.
- [`stats`](#stats): Big numbers with labels (e.g. 250+ clients). Columns default to the number of items (max 4).
- [`testimonials`](#testimonials): Customer quotes with name, role and optional avatar.

## cards

Grid of hand-written cards (image, meta, title, text, link). For listing real pages use the collection block.

**Content fields** (under `cards:`):

- `eyebrow` text: Eyebrow
- `heading` text: Heading
- `intro` textarea: Intro (markdown)
- `columns` select (2|3|4): Columns
- `items` list: Cards
  - `image` filepicker: Image
  - `image_alt` text: Image alt
  - `meta` text: Meta / label
  - `title` text: Title
  - `text` textarea: Text (markdown)
  - `url` text: Link URL
  - `link_label` text: Link label
- `buttons` list: Buttons
  - `label` text: Label
  - `url` text: URL
  - `style` select (primary|secondary|ghost): Style
  - `icon` iconpicker: Icon
  - `new_tab` toggle (1|0): Open in new tab

**Example:**

```yaml
blocks:
  -
    type: cards
    cards:
      heading: 'Our work'
      columns: 3
      items:
        -
          title: 'Project one'
          text: 'Short description.'
          url: /work/one
          meta: Branding
          image: one.jpg
          link_label: View
```

## collection

Lists real pages as cards or a list. source: @self.children, a route like /blog, or "@taxonomy.tag: news".

**Content fields** (under `collection:`):

- `eyebrow` text: Eyebrow
- `heading` text: Heading
- `intro` textarea: Intro (markdown)
- `source` text: Source
- `limit` number: Limit
- `order_by` select (date|title|folder|default): Order by
- `order_dir` select (desc|asc): Direction
- `layout` select (cards|list): Layout
- `columns` select (2|3|4): Columns (cards)
- `show_image` toggle (1|0): Show images
- `show_date` toggle (1|0): Show dates
- `buttons` list: Buttons
  - `label` text: Label
  - `url` text: URL
  - `style` select (primary|secondary|ghost): Style
  - `icon` iconpicker: Icon
  - `new_tab` toggle (1|0): Open in new tab

**Example:**

```yaml
blocks:
  -
    type: collection
    collection:
      heading: 'Latest posts'
      source: /blog
      limit: 3
      order_by: date
      order_dir: desc
      layout: cards
      buttons:
        -
          label: 'All posts'
          url: /blog
          style: secondary
```
